_comment: FERPA gate for subagent delegation: student-data paths and telltale content must never be handed to a worker (allow_agents empty = block every worker; handle inline, where guard_ferpa.py then also polices tool calls). The gate fails CLOSED. Schema follows the frugal plugin's examples/frugal-sensitivity.example.json: patterns are Python regexes over all string fields of the spawn; paths are fnmatch globs over whitespace-separated tokens (* matches /).

rules.name: ferpa-student-data
rules._comment: Live data zone, raw student extracts, any sqlite DB, DB backups, roster exports, and the doctor flag that prints student ids. data/sample/** (synthetic) deliberately does NOT match.
